set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-later; milestone-view.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: September 25 owner-approved design request; scheduled later without a release-number promise. Atlas must continue to show unavailable rather than mint absent scientific structure.

Remaining / next action: Expose all six landmark epistemic statuses through the declared non-colour channel; status and confidence remain separate. Qualify the exact producer schema/fixture and StoryAtlas consumer before claiming visible completion.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Landmarks carry status but the six-way channel was never minted; routes show it by weight/dash only.
Requested by StoryAtlas (storyatlas4s docs/plans/2026-09-25-north-star-plan.md, owner-approved 2026-09-25). Atlas draws only supplied structure (ADR 0002 D4); until this lands Atlas shows an explicit unavailable state.
